test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

__The most worrying aspect__ of climate change is the effect it has on the world’s food supply.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'.** i.e.** 'No improvement'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence addresses** the concerning aspects of climate change.
 
• *"The most worrying aspect" *is already in its correct grammatical form.
 
• The** sentence aims to** highlight a singular aspect which is the effect on the world's food supply.
 
• Therefore, **no improvement** is needed in the underlined part.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'The most worrying aspect of climate change is the effect it has on the world’s food supply.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"A worried aspects"** is grammatically incorrect due to the mismatch between singular "a" and plural "aspects".
 
• **"The most worrying aspects"** would indicate multiple aspects, which is not the case in the sentence.
 
• "**A most worry aspect"** is not correct in terms of adjective usage.
